article.title: Hierarchical interlocked orthogonal faulting in the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence
article.scientific_question: What hierarchical, orthogonal fault geometry and rupture structure explains the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence when dense template-matched seismicity is relatively relocated?
article.sequence: 2019 Mw 6.4 foreshock, Mw 7.1 mainshock and first 21 days of aftershocks.
article.catalog_relationship: Constructs/uses a high-resolution template-matched and relatively relocated catalog released as the official SCEDC QTM product; QTM mixes successfully relocated and initial-only rows.

catalog.name: SCEDC QTM Ridgecrest template-matched catalog
catalog.scientific_purpose: Relative fault geometry, cluster structure and relocation diagnostics for the Ridgecrest sequence.
catalog.event_definition: Template-matched event rows with initial and, when supported by differential-time clustering, relocated hypocenters; nbranch greater than 1 marks successful multi-event relocation.

local_audit.article_local_discrepancy: Article gives an approximate more-than-111,000 M>0.5 first-21-day population; local archive has 111,918 rows across mixed nbranch/status and is not asserted to be an exact M>0.5 subset.

suitable_metrics: relative fault geometry and cluster reconstruction
comparison of initial versus relocated solutions
unsuitable_metrics: treating all 111,918 rows as equally relocated
using QTM Mw 7.1 depth as absolute truth
exact reproduction of detection/relocation thresholds before obtaining Science DC1
independence_conditions: Shares SCSN/SCEDC waveform lineage with Shelly and operational baseline, but QTM is a distinct template/cluster release.
Use nbranch>1 for structural metrics and retain initial-only rows as a separate population.
limitations: Science DC1 is not local, so exact template/differential-time parameters and station counts remain unknown.
Mainshock depth is poorly constrained; use SCSN hypocenter for absolute comparison.
13 duplicate origin times exist despite unique event IDs.

product_semantics.qtm_all: 111,918-row official SCEDC archive combining initial and relocated solutions.
product_semantics.relocated_subset: Rows with nbranch >1; 46,512 full-release rows and 6,463 under frozen common mask.
product_semantics.initial_subset: Rows with nbranch =1; 65,406 full-release rows and 6,305 under frozen common mask.
product_semantics.error_fields: eh, ez and et use −1 for unavailable values; do not treat −1 as a physical error.

construction_workflow.summary: SCSN/SCEDC routine waveforms seed template matching and hidden-event detection; differential times are clustered and relatively relocated into the SCEDC QTM format. Exact thresholds remain in the missing Science DC1.

input_data.name: SCSN/SCEDC waveform and routine-event archive
input_data.channels_sampling: Not specified in main article parse
input_data.availability_conditions: Station count and exact availability require DC1.

evidence.note: Network lineage and missing station count.

input_data.name: Routine events/picks for templates
input_data.availability_conditions: Exact template population and thresholds are in DC1.

stages.name: Template matching and hidden-event detection
stages.purpose: Recover events below routine network thresholds.
stages.method: Apply the article's template-matching workflow; do not infer unreported thresholds.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Exact thresholds, template lengths and station selection unresolved.

stages.name: Differential-time measurement
stages.method: Measure differential times among template-related events.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Use qndiffP, qndiffS and RMS fields in released rows.
stages.dependencies: Depends on template matches and waveform overlap.

stages.name: Clustered relative relocation
stages.method: Cluster events and solve relative locations; release marks successful solutions with nbranch greater than 1.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Retain error fields and interpret −1 as unavailable.

stages.name: Quality/export and structural interpretation
stages.purpose: Publish mixed QTM schema and use relocated subset for fault geometry.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Use SCSN hypocenter for Mw 7.1 absolute depth.
Do not treat all rows as relocated.

construction_workflow.final_output: Official SCEDC QTM archive with 111,918 rows, including 46,512 nbranch>1 relocated solutions and 65,406 initial-only rows; frozen common mask contains 12,768 rows (6,463 relocated).

scientific_findings.statement: The relocated subset resolves hierarchical interlocked orthogonal faulting and supports structural comparison at roughly 100 m horizontal and 350 m vertical relative resolution.
Initial-only and successfully relocated rows must be separated because the archive combines operational locations with differential-time-supported solutions.

evidence.locator: Provenance and native schema; Full archive audit

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Q1 for nbranch>1 relative fault geometry and relocation diagnostics; Q2–Q3 for initial-only rows and absolute mainshock depth.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Secondary structural/relocation reference against Shelly and Liu, with nbranch-specific metrics.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Compare with Shelly Data S1 and Liu Table S1 under the common mask; use SCSN hypocenter for absolute mainshock checks.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Cluster geometry, relative location, differential-time support, error-field calibration and initial-versus-relocated contrast.
benchmark_context.caveats: Do not infer missing DC1 parameters or treat all rows as high-quality relocations; preserve duplicate times and event IDs.

evidence.locator: Quality and limitations; Frozen benchmark-window audit

missing_information: Science DC1 is not archived locally.

Article's approximate more-than-111,000 M>0.5 population is not directly reproducible from local mixed QTM rows without DC1 definition.
